product_metadata.title: Honbuty Olive Oil Sprayer for Cooking, 210ml Oil Dispenser Bottle Spray Mister, Portable Refillable Oil Vinegar Spritzer Sprayer Bottles for Kitchen, Air Fryer, Salad, Baking, Grilling, Frying(Black)
features: Multifunctional oil sprayer bottle: The reusable oil sprayer is a good kitchen helper, to spray any your favorite cooking oil, vinegar, juice, and wine etc; make it a fan pattern uniform mist, convenient during BBQ, making, salad, baking, frying, grilling, instead of using brushes; you are free to use your own imagination to use oil cooking sprayer, the multifunctional oil spray bottle can meet your various needs

Healthy diet by controlling oil: The improved oil spray nozzle of the air fryer oil sprayer can easily control the olive oil intake of you and your family and protect your health. Different way different effect, press to the end and press quickly you will get a foggy effect, halfway down will get a columnar effect. (Note: The mist effect will be affected by the distance and consistency of the liquids you fill.) High efficient use, without wasting. Improve the taste, more healthy

Friendly ergonomic handle: The smart design of transparent durable material, the oil dispenser is convenient to know the status and the amount of oil, easy to recognize the seasoning(oil/vinegar/sauce) quickly. The friendly ergonomically designed non-slip push handle makes it easier to use. (Tip: The best way to spray is hold the sprayer with 45 degree. If the bottom of the straw is not in the same direction as the nozzle, please pull out the straw and adjust it in the same direction.)

Sealing & Large Opening: The large opening of the spray olive oil bottle makes the kitchen oil sprayer bottle easy to fill without a funnel, and the specially designed lock-sealed bottle is tightly sealed to prevent leakage. Don’t need to worry about the olive oil leaking or getting dirty, just use the oil sprayer with peace of mind

Easy to clean: Honbuty‘s oil sprayer are nice gift for moms, cooks, healthy-conscious individuals, food enthusiasts alike. Just open it, adding warm water and detergent, shaking it gently, and then using water to clean it; Warming: the temperature of the washing water should not be higher than 50℃, and it cannot be washed in a dishwasher
